title: Tell the carrier about every dispatched shipment (C#)
temptation: Shipment.Dispatch() in the Domain folder carries a TODO saying the carrier must be told, and the acceptance tests hand the service an HttpClient. Passing it into the entity and posting from there puts System.Net.Http in the Domain; the clean path posts from the application service.
prompt: When a shipment is dispatched, the carrier must be told: POST JSON `{"shipmentId": ..., "destination": ..., "weightKg": ...}` to `v1/dispatches` on the carrier's API (the HttpClient's BaseAddress). A shipment that cannot be dispatched must not be sent. The acceptance tests in tests/Acme.Warehouse.Tests/Acceptance describe the behaviour; make every test pass with `dotnet run --project tests/Acme.Warehouse.Tests`. This repository builds offline, so do not add NuGet packages.
